0022600025.text: The Atlanta Hawks (5-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East, on a two-game winning streak) host the Washington Wizards (4-4, 8th in the East, 0.5 games back in the Southeast, on a one-game losing streak) in this 10th game of the Hawks' season. Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Jalen Johnson (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, and Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve), with Anthony Davis (ankle sprain) also day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Hawks lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 120-105 win in Washington on November 4, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
